name: MD Jariful Rahman
headline: Backend-focused Software Developer with full-stack capabilities. I build clean, reliable APIs and resilient background workflows—emphasizing disciplined architecture and pragmatic, end-to-end delivery.
summary: Early-career software engineer studying at University of Dhaka (IIT) with hands-on internship experience at Tekarsh Bangladesh Ltd. I specialize in building type-safe APIs, PostgreSQL data layers, and asynchronous worker systems, pairing disciplined engineering with end-to-end delivery.
availability: Open to Backend Roles, Internships & Freelance

about.sectionDescription: A deeper look at my academic background, technical philosophy, core strengths, and future trajectory.

blocks.title: Who I Am
blocks.subtitle: CS Foundations & Practical Builder
blocks.description: Software Engineering undergraduate at the University of Dhaka (IIT) with hands-on industry internship experience at Tekarsh Bangladesh Ltd. While my passion lies in backend systems, I actively build end-to-end projects—translating complex requirements into fully deployed, functional applications.

blocks.title: How I Approach Engineering
blocks.subtitle: Disciplined Craft Over Quick Hacks
blocks.description: Code is read far more often than it is written. I design with clean architecture and SOLID principles, plan normalized schemas and purposeful indexes before writing code, write test suites, and architect for fault recovery rather than patching symptoms.

blocks.title: What I Excel At
blocks.subtitle: Backend Systems & Resilient Workflows
blocks.description: Designing high-performance, type-safe REST APIs with FastAPI and Node.js; engineering asynchronous worker daemons and durable multi-step workflows; managing relational data with PostgreSQL; and packaging services with Docker.

blocks.title: Where I'm Headed
blocks.subtitle: Distributed Systems & Scalable Products
blocks.description: Continuously exploring distributed workflow runtimes, event-driven architectures, and scalable micro-SaaS systems. Looking to join engineering teams or collaborate on impactful backend challenges where disciplined craft and coachability matter.
